versions.changelog:
- Comprehensive documentation restructured: all major references reorganized and renamed for clearer build stages (`00-understanding`, `10-setup`, `20-develop`, etc.).
- Expanded stage-based reference system: new navigation to guide users through understanding, setup, development, capability extension, testing, deployment, and experience pitfalls.
- Environment setup, scaffolding, and workflow inspection guides added to help users start from scratch.
- Capability mounting, tool pipeline, dynamic plugins, and deployment packaging now have dedicated, clearly indexed guides.
- Overview and mental model materials updated for greater conceptual clarity and improved new-user onboarding.

- Major documentation and structure refactor: plugin reference files reorganized into topic-based subdirectories (overview, workflow, runtime, capability, deployment, experience).
- Expanded skill guide with a new "0.5 运行时全景" section detailing plugin execution lifecycle, runtime positions, chain of execution, and hook points in DeepSeek Harness.
- All concept deep-dive links updated to reflect new file structure.
- Added further technical/DSH-specific notes (runtime hooks, event timings, DSH customization) to core philosophy and runtime sections.
- Reference and checklist sections updated with new file paths and a more logical learning/support sequence.
- Old top-level reference files removed and replaced by structured, categorized documentation for easier navigation and maintenance.

cordis-plugin-builder v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for building Cordis-compatible plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
- Provides step-by-step plugin development guidance, including key framework concepts (Context, Service, Event, Fiber, inject, effect, Config, Scope).
- Covers the full development lifecycle: design principles, plugin formats, integration points (tools, prompts, skills, Client UI), dynamic/plugin loading, multi-language bridging, and deployment options.
- Includes detailed best practices, common pitfalls, and comprehensive checklists for review and delivery.
- Offers curated references for both conceptual understanding and practical implementation steps.
